commands.name: bundle

options.name: --bundle-output-path
options.description: Output archive file or directory; defaults to  <project>-<timestamp> in the current directory

options.name: --bundle-type
options.description: Bundle type: zip (default), tar, tar.gz or directory

options.name: --finalized
options.description: Bundle only plans of finalized releases (the  default)

options.name: --project
options.description: The project directory; defaults to the current  directory

options.name: --since
options.description: Bundle only the releases after the named one (a  continuation bundle)

options.name: --test
options.description: Bundle every plan regardless of release status

commands.description: Bundle a project's plans and their steps into a  deployment archive or directory

commands.name: deploy

options.name: --bundle-type
options.description: Bundle type: zip, tar, tar.gz or directory; inferred  from the bundle path when omitted

options.name: --commit-level
options.description: Commit progress after every 'plan' or only  after every 'release'; default release

options.name: --driver
options.description: Database driver; its parameters are passed as  --<driver>-<parameter> <value>. See 'drivers  list' and 'drivers parameters <driver>'

options.name: --log
options.description: Append timestamped progress lines to this log file

options.name: --rollback
options.description: Undo the deployment: 'on-error' after a  failure, 'on-success' after a successful deployment; default none

options.name: --timeout
options.description: Step script timeout in seconds, 0 for no timeout;  default 300
